entries.dialogueText: I called Lucita, Hugo and Titus to my council chambers for a security update.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus insisted on sweeping the room..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus insisted on sweeping the room before Vina and I sat down. Hugo was next to arrive, early as usual.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus insisted on sweeping the room..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus insisted on sweeping the room before I sat down. Hugo was next to arrive, early as usual.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your Majesty. How are you faring?""
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty. How are you faring?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm still in shock. How was such a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm still in shock. How was such an attack allowed to take place in the King's presence?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm just fine. It's the Wehzek vic..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm just fine. It's the Wehzek victims of the bombing I'm concerned about."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm doing all right. So is Mother,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm doing all right. So is Mother, in case you cared."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm worried about Wehlen's reactio..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm worried about Wehlen's reaction. Smolak hasn't even made a public statement yet."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Perhaps no news is good news in th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps no news is good news in this case."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I can only hope Duchess Azaro will..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can only hope Duchess Azaro will enlighten us on that matter."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It was God's will that you survive..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was God's will that you survived. Losing two kings within a year would have been catastrophic for this country."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Of course the Queen Mother's safet..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course the Queen Mother's safety is of the utmost importance to me. But losing two kings in a matter of months would have been catastrophic."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""At ease, Duchess Azaro.""
entries.dialogueText: "At ease, Duchess Azaro."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I need a status report. Now.""
entries.dialogueText: "I need a status report. Now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We're not all gentlemen. Do not fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're not all gentlemen. Do not forget the presence of the princess."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for joining us, Duchess..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for joining us, Duchess Azaro. Can you update us on the Zille situation?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Certainly, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Certainly, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Thank you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita sat and flipped open a dossi..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita sat and flipped open a dossier.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Still standing, she picked a dossie..."
entries.dialogueText: Still standing, she picked a dossier up off the table and flipped it open.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I'll reiterate what we already kno..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll reiterate what we already know."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""At 1605 hours on December 8, 1950,..."
entries.dialogueText: "At 1605 hours on December 8, 1950, an explosive object detonated in Smolak Square in the city of Zille. It had been planted beneath grandstands that were set up that morning."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Seated in those stands were a mix..."
entries.dialogueText: "Seated in those stands were a mix of civilians and political figures who had been invited to the Friendship Day event, all of Wehzek heritage."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The most recent casualty report st..."
entries.dialogueText: "The most recent casualty report states that three civilians were killed in the blast. Of the 14 injured, all are now in stable condition."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't forget that right before the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't forget that right before the attack, someone screamed 'For the King.'"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, yes, we know all that. What's..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, yes, we know all that. What's new?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Was anyone important among the dea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Was anyone important among the dead?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank God. From what I saw, it cou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank God. From what I saw, it could have been much worse."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""No, the most prominent Wehzek atte..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, the most prominent Wehzek attendees all made it out unharmed. Wehlen's guards saw to that."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It's not good for us regardless.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's not good for us regardless."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I was getting to that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I was getting to that."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I haven't forgotten. Nor has Wehle..."
entries.dialogueText: "I haven't forgotten. Nor has Wehlen."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She turned a page."
entries.dialogueText: She turned a page.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Based on the scant evidence availa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Based on the scant evidence available, Wehlen's intelligence agency suspects that the Rizian nationalist group Su Omina was behind the crime."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I don't understand why Cousin Rico..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't understand why Cousin Rico would even support a group like that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I appreciate the boy's efforts. Bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate the boy's efforts. But I wish he would coordinate them with me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's true. National identity shoul..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's true. National identity should be secondary to one's loyalty to the throne."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's rubbish. The monarchy and t..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's rubbish. The monarchy and the nation of Rizia cannot be separated from one another. I appreciate Rico's efforts to protect both."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please don't change the subject, V..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please don't change the subject, Vina."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, Rico has no right using the T..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Rico has no right using the Toras name to serve his own xenophobic agenda."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""If I may, Your Grace, why have you..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I may, Your Grace, why have you never once thrown your own weight behind Su Omina if you support its ideals?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Agreed, Let's get back to the topi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Agreed, Let's get back to the topic at hand. Although..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Future or not, we have no concrete..."
entries.dialogueText: "Future or not, we have no concrete proof Su Omina was behind the attack. All we have is Wehlen's word."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Then what are your foreign intelli..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then what are your foreign intelligence agents good for? They didn't even predict this would happen!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And it's in Wehlen's interest to p..."
entries.dialogueText: "And it's in Wehlen's interest to pin the blame for the bombing on Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rico has no right using the Toras..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rico has no right using the Toras name to support a xenophobic agenda."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know the way these groups functi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know the way these groups function. It's only a short leap from talk to bloodshed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Without them, Wehlen's criminals w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Without them, Wehlen's criminals would be running roughshod all over our country."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What more do we need? It seems lik..."
entries.dialogueText: "What more do we need? It seems like a cut-and-dried case to me."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""That's part of the reason why I've..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's part of the reason why I've been asking you to visit Iza. Obviously the King should be kept abreast of the group's activities."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Surely you don't truly feel that w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Surely you don't truly feel that way, or you wouldn't have lent your support to the group."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He smiled warmly at Vina. My daught..."
entries.dialogueText: He smiled warmly at Vina. My daughter looked away.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""My son is as much of a Toras as yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "My son is as much of a Toras as you or Princess Vina. And frankly, he should be commended for his efforts to protect the country from miscreants."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Do you really think the Wehzek mis..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you really think the Wehzek miscreants streaming into this country are doing so out of loyalty to you?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""They've been doing the best they c..."
entries.dialogueText: "They've been doing the best they can with their limited resources."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Exactly. We still haven't ruled ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly. We still haven't ruled out the possibility that President Smolak himself ordered it."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Have you not considered the possib..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have you not considered the possibility that the attack was staged by Wehlen itself? Or another party interested in weakening both of us?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Or another party interested in wea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Or another party interested in weakening the both of us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why have we not looked into this o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why have we not looked into this ourselves?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""With an increased foreign intellig..."
entries.dialogueText: "With an increased foreign intelligence budget, we could commission a full investigation into the Zille incident and take measures to prevent such an event from reoccurring."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Our foreign intelligence agency is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our foreign intelligence agency is hamstrung by its limited resources, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Pardon me, ma'am. Major. Duchess.""
entries.dialogueText: "Pardon me, ma'am. Major. Duchess."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "All eyes turned towards the man in..."
entries.dialogueText: All eyes turned towards the man in the gold blazer.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""May I point out that you weren't p..."
entries.dialogueText: "May I point out that you weren't present on the day of the Zille incident. The King and I were."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Prior to His Majesty's arrival, my..."
entries.dialogueText: "Prior to His Majesty's arrival, my men and I attempted to clear the square of every conceivable danger. However, we could not be everywhere at once."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What's your point, Mr. Gordion?""
entries.dialogueText: "What's your point, Mr. Gordion?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You missed a bomb. That counts as..."
entries.dialogueText: "You missed a bomb. That counts as a massive lapse on the Golden Guard's part."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You helped save our lives back the..."
entries.dialogueText: "You helped save our lives back there. No need to make excuses."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It shouldn't have been your job to..."
entries.dialogueText: "It shouldn't have been your job to find the bomb. It was Wehlen's."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""It shouldn't have even come to tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "It shouldn't have even come to that point."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Our job is to take every measure t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our job is to take every measure to protect the King of Rizia. In that respect, we failed."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Our job is to take every measure t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our job is to take every measure to protect the King of Rizia. In that respect, we failed."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""This event has shown how vulnerabl..."
entries.dialogueText: "This event has shown how vulnerable you and the royal family truly are, and how ill-equipped my men and I are to seek out and neutralize threats to your safety."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Therefore, it is my opinion that a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Therefore, it is my opinion that any emergency funding allocated in the wake of the Zille attack should go towards re-expanding the Golden Guard."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita's jaw dropped. Hugo eyed Tit..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita's jaw dropped. Hugo eyed Titus uneasily.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Ma'am, it's important to recognize..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ma'am, it's important to recognize the historical significance of the Golden Guard. Until quite recently, our role extended far beyond mere guardians of the King."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Previously, the Guard had the auth..."
entries.dialogueText: "Previously, the Guard had the authority to conduct sensitive internal investigations without getting caught up in red tape. The Royal Family and Rizia were both more secure because of it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good point. Before giving more fun..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good point. Before giving more funding to foreign intelligence, I need to make sure I'm safe within my own borders."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What kind of investigations did yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "What kind of investigations did you have in mind, Captain?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Can you not make more efficient us..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can you not make more efficient use of the funding you already have. Captain?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We need to find out who's behind t..."
entries.dialogueText: "We need to find out who's behind this bombing. Can the Golden Guard help with that?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""That's precisely what I'm suggesti..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's precisely what I'm suggesting. We need to recruit qualified individuals and equip them with the technology to carry out covert surveillance in Iza--"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Your Majesty, given the resources,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, given the resources, we could recruit a number of qualified individuals and equip them with the technology to carry out covert surveillance in Iza--"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The type of investigation I'm prop..."
entries.dialogueText: "The type of investigation I'm proposing would require more, sir. We need to recruit qualified individuals and equip them with the technology to carry out covert surveillance in Iza--"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""With respect, sir, we don't know w..."
entries.dialogueText: "With respect, sir, we don't know whether it's a dead end. And investigating an organization with ties to the royal family is exactly the kind of sensitive mission the Golden Guard was built for."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She, Hugo and Titus glared at each..."
entries.dialogueText: She, Hugo and Titus glared at each other.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Excuse me, Your Majesty. My fellow..."
entries.dialogueText: "Excuse me, Your Majesty. My fellow councilors. These stairs never get easier."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Take a moment, Mr. Esquibel.""
entries.dialogueText: "Take a moment, Mr. Esquibel."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The tension was broken by a knock o..."
entries.dialogueText: The tension was broken by a knock on the door. Laurento came in, clearly out of breath.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't interrupt us. We're in the m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't interrupt us. We're in the middle of an important security briefing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What's going on?""
entries.dialogueText: "What's going on?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I understand, Your Majesty. But yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand, Your Majesty. But you're going to want to hear this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento sat down. After catching h..."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento sat down. After catching his breath, he continued.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I've just received word from Wehle..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've just received word from Wehlen's foreign minister. President Smolak plans to make it public that Rizian nationalists were involved in the Zille incident."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita's hands closed into fists."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita's hands closed into fists.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Furthermore, given the contents of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Furthermore, given the contents of the King's speech just prior to the attack, chances are that King Romus himself will come under fire for inciting the violence."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He shook his head sadly."
entries.dialogueText: He shook his head sadly.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I did advise you to maintain an ai..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did advise you to maintain an air of civility, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Past is past. We have to focus on..."
entries.dialogueText: "Past is past. We have to focus on what we're going to do next."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do not question my decisions, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "Do not question my decisions, Mr. Esquibel."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I didn't incite anything. I merely..."
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't incite anything. I merely told the truth."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sorry. I must have gotten carr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry. I must have gotten carried away."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Our relations with Wehlen have bee..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our relations with Wehlen have been cordial enough that Smolak will not immediately blame the crown. But he will be expecting a response."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""My sincerest apologies. Let's focu..."
entries.dialogueText: "My sincerest apologies. Let's focus on how we're going to respond."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Correct. Wehlen will be expecting..."
entries.dialogueText: "Correct. Wehlen will be expecting a response from us."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""On their own, your words might not..."
entries.dialogueText: "On their own, your words might not have been considered incendiary. But their timing was most unfortunate."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""What's done is done. But now Wehle..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's done is done. But now Wehlen will be expecting a response from us."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Wehlen will be expecting a respons..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wehlen will be expecting a response from us."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""He's just testing us. His governme..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's just testing us. His government can't prove anything."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Smolak is just testing us. His gov..."
entries.dialogueText: "Smolak is just testing us. His government can't prove anything."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Still, an apology for your harsh l..."
entries.dialogueText: "Still, an apology for your harsh language would be in order so as not to inflame relations further."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How dare he insult us with these b..."
entries.dialogueText: "How dare he insult us with these baseless accusations?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""An apology won't be enough. I have..."
entries.dialogueText: "An apology won't be enough. I have to point the finger somewhere."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This makes me certain that Wehlen..."
entries.dialogueText: "This makes me certain that Wehlen was behind the bombing. They're trying to weaken our claim on Zille."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lack of proof never stopped Wehlen..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lack of proof never stopped Wehlen from waging war on the Bluds. The Wehzeks are irrational."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll do whatever I have to do to g..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll do whatever I have to do to get President Smolak back on our side."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""That's dangerous, Your Majesty. If..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's dangerous, Your Majesty. If we begin offering concessions, there are no limits to what Wehlen will demand."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You see now why I want to launch a..."
entries.dialogueText: "You see now why I want to launch an investigation? Imagine the reaction once it comes out that Smolak attacked his own people."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Yes, I can't imagine any response..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I can't imagine any response that would pacify that man."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I understand the need to apologize..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand the need to apologize. What I won't do is blame my own people for what happened."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""An apology would be an admission o..."
entries.dialogueText: "An apology would be an admission of guilt. I can't do that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll do whatever I have to do to g..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll do whatever I have to do to get the President back on our side."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""That's right. If we let Smolak bel..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's right. If we let Smolak believe we have something to apologize for, there are no limits to what he'll demand."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""People are dead, Your Majesty. Som..."
entries.dialogueText: "People are dead, Your Majesty. Someone must take the blame."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""That's dangerous, Your Majesty. If..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's dangerous, Your Majesty. If we begin offering concessions, there are no limits to what Wehlen will demand."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Quite right. There's no need to th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Quite right. There's no need to throw Rico to the Wehzek wolves."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Then point it right back at Wehlen..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then point it right back at Wehlen. Launch an investigation. Call Smolak's bluff."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""May I ask what the five of you wer..."

entries.dialogueText: "I must say... last we spoke, You Majesty, I was under the impression that the Golden Guard had your full support."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Our conversation left me with quit..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our conversation left me with quite optimistic expectations, and it's disappointing that they won't be coming to fruition."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I hope this isn't indicative of fu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope this isn't indicative of future commitments."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Enough with your baseless insinuat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Enough with your baseless insinuations. Circumstances change, and I must make decisions in the best interests of Rizia, not those of the Golden Guard."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I respect you as my guardsman, Cap..."
entries.dialogueText: "I respect you as my guardsman, Captain, but this is an internationally sensitive incident. We've got to treat it with the seriousness it deserves."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sometimes even the best-laid plans..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sometimes even the best-laid plans can take unexpected turns. I'll try to make it up to you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And you'll continue to have my ful..."
entries.dialogueText: "And you'll continue to have my full support. I simply agree with Duchess Azaro on the course of how this investigation should proceed."

entries.dialogueText: "My support for the Golden Guard remains as steadfast as ever, and your insinuations are unfounded. Circumstances change, and decisions must be made in the best interest of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And I must admit my disappointment..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I must admit my disappointment in you, Captain. You, of all people, should know your place and respect the decisions made for the greater good of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Life has a way of throwing surpris..."
entries.dialogueText: "Life has a way of throwing surprises into our best-laid plans. I'll try to make it up to you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And you'll continue to have my ful..."

entries.dialogueText: "Very well. But in the future, please include me in confidential internal security meetings. I'd appreciate being a part of the conversation."

entries.dialogueText: "You'll be included in such meetings if I deem it necessary."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""What you call 'red tape,' I call a..."
entries.dialogueText: "What you call 'red tape,' I call accountability. You are asking for permission to act outside the law."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I am asking for permission to beco..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am asking for permission to become a more agile, flexible arm of the law than any division currently in operation. This will benefit us both."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""With a full-fledged division under..."
entries.dialogueText: "With a full-fledged division under my command, I could also easily send a team to Iza to confirm or rule out Su Omina's involvement in what happened."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""All well and good, Your Majesty, b..."
entries.dialogueText: "All well and good, Your Majesty, but the fact remains that national security is not Captain Gordion's area of expertise."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Now that the subject has been broa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now that the subject has been broached, I will gently point out that national security is not Captain Gordion's area of expertise."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Your Majesty, you recently conveye..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, you recently conveyed your apprehension over re-expanding the Golden Guard's ranks and duties. But this incident would serve as an excellent opportunity for us to demonstrate our capabilities."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita spoke up sweetly."
